acceptanceCriteria: With owner-provided non-interactive Gemini authentication (GEMINI_API_KEY or Vertex), a disposable-fixture `corvint-tasks dispatch` run launches the documented Gemini argv and policy from docs/TASKS-SUPERVISION.md. The worker claims, the dispatcher hands it off (attempt show: cause HANDOFF), the `finished` event carries Gemini's final reply, and SIGINT stops the dispatcher with 0 workers left.
The observed stream-json shape is compared with TestCALV0058_SummaryReadsHostFinalText's Gemini case, and the case is updated if they differ.
The build log records the run, and the CAL-V0-055 traceability row and S11 evidence cite it.
body:
Observed 2026-10-01 while adding Gemini CLI host support to `corvint-tasks dispatch` (V1-0475; build log docs/build-log/2026-10-01-tasks-dispatch-gemini.md).

The summary reader and the documented argv/policy are derived from the installed Gemini CLI 0.54.0 bundle, not from a live run.

Blocker: on this machine `~/.gemini` uses personal Google OAuth (`selectedType: oauth-personal`). A headless `gemini -p ... -o stream-json` probe fails with `IneligibleTierError`, because that client is no longer supported for Gemini Code Assist for individuals. No GEMINI_API_KEY, GOOGLE_API_KEY or Vertex variables are set.

Expected: a headless worker run streams init/message/tool_use/tool_result/result events.
Actual: authentication error before any model turn.

The owner must supply the authentication; an agent must not create accounts or enter keys.
title: dispatch: live-qualify the Gemini CLI host once non-interactive auth is available
